    UngrabEvent
    Sent when one of the following events occur on the grabbed window: it looses focus, but not to one of the owned windows mouse click on the outside area happens (except for one of the owned windows) switch to another application or desktop happens click in the non-client area of the owning window or this window happens Notice that this event is not generated on mouse click inside of the window area.
